desc:
DOES19 Las Vegas — Learn how real-world enterprises that adopted functional programming principles and adapted them to their line-of-business systems achieved greater resiliency, faster time-to-delivery, and lower total cost of ownership.

Fabulous Fortunes, Fewer Failures, and Faster Fixes from Functional Fundamentals - Scott Havens

Scott is the former Director of Software Engineering at Jet.com
